IDIQ for Hazardous Waste Drums

PNS intends to solicit for the purchase of Hazardous Waste Drums for the Portsmouth Naval Shipyard, Kittery, ME. 

This requirement will be solicited as a Full & Open procurement, and the size status for this requirement is 600 employees.

Additional details will be provided shortly.
